title: Márta Mészáros and Béla Tarr: Realism and Cosmic Time
grammar: Instantaneous succession and non-negotiable immediacy with mihelyt ('as soon as / no sooner than')
goal: I can say, using mihelyt, what happens the moment a film by Márta Mészáros or Béla Tarr begins.
I can use mihelyt to express strict immediate sequence and instant temporal consequence.
I can name the main features of Mészáros's diary films and of Tarr's slow cinema.
